name: Pit Fighter's Harness
kind: armour set for the villagers (skinned to their CharacterArmature)
description: An arena champion's harness for Lord Velscour's pits: a studded leather vest with his sigil on the back and his copper V where its iron straps cross, dark red pteruges, a wide iron belt, one great spiked iron pauldron, spiked knees and a blackened great helm with a shading brow.

meshes.Armor: body, arms, legs and the set's gauntlets

hide_when_worn: the villager's body meshes (every mesh not named V_*)
